display_title: My New Mom Is My Friend's Mom
description:
Jake returns home from the military to a tense household where his stepmother, Susan, battles emotional distance from her husband. Forbidden desires grow between them through a series of intimate and awkward encounters. Their unresolved tensions threaten to shatter the fragile family dynamic.
